items.informal_name: Evaluation of Variables in Multivariate Polynomial Ring Homomorphism
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] (f : R →+* S₁)
  (g : σ → S₁) (i : σ), (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom f g) (MvPolynomial.X i) = g i
items.informal_description: For any variable $ X_i $ in the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\sigma] $, the evaluation homomorphism defined by a ring homomorphism $ f : R \to S_1 $ and a variable assignment $ g : \sigma \to S_1 $ satisfies $ \text{eval}(X_i) = g(i) $. This asserts that under the canonical evaluation map constructed from coefficient mapping $ f $ and variable assignment $ g $, each indeterminate $ X_i $ is sent to its assigned value $ g(i) $ in the target semiring $ S_1 $.

items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] (f : R →+* S₁)
  (g : σ → S₁) (n : σ), MvPolynomial.eval₂ f g (MvPolynomial.X n) = g n
items.informal_description: For any variable $X_n$ in the multivariate polynomial ring, $(X_n).eval₂ f g = g(n)$.

items.informal_name: Eval₂ Coincides with Ring Homomorphism on Multivariate Polynomials
items.type:
∀ {S : Type v} [inst : CommRing S] {R : Type u} (c : ℤ →+* S) (f : MvPolynomial R ℤ →+* S) (x : MvPolynomial R ℤ),
  MvPolynomial.eval₂ c (⇑f ∘ MvPolynomial.X) x = f x
items.informal_description: For any ring homomorphism $ f : R[\sigma] \to S $, coefficient map $ c : \mathbb{Z} \to S $, and polynomial $ x \in R[\sigma] $, evaluating $ x $ using the `eval₂` function with coefficient map $ c $ and variable map $ f \circ X $ yields the same result as applying $ f $ directly to $ x $, i.e., $ \text{eval}_2(c, f \circ X, x) = f(x) $.

items.informal_name: Compatibility of Evaluation with Univariate to Multivariate Polynomial Embedding
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} {σ : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S]
  (f : σ → S) (i : σ) (p : Polynomial R),
  (MvPolynomial.aeval f) ((Polynomial.toMvPolynomial i) p) = (Polynomial.aeval (f i)) p
items.informal_description: For any function $ f : \sigma \to S $, element $ i \in \sigma $, and polynomial $ p \in R[X] $, evaluating the multivariate polynomial obtained by substituting the variable $ X $ with the $ i $-th variable in $ \sigma $ using the evaluation map defined by $ f $ is equal to evaluating $ p $ at $ f(i) $.

items.informal_name: Composition of Evaluation and Substitution in Multivariate Polynomials Equals Univariate Evaluation
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : σ → R) (i : σ),
  (MvPolynomial.eval f).comp ↑(Polynomial.toMvPolynomial i) = Polynomial.evalRingHom (f i)
items.informal_description: The composition of the evaluation homomorphism $\operatorname{eval}_f : R[\sigma] \to R$ and the substitution homomorphism $\operatorname{toMvPolynomial}_i : R[X] \to R[\sigma]$ substituting variable $X$ with the $i$-th variable in $\sigma$ is equal to the univariate polynomial evaluation homomorphism $\operatorname{eval}_{f(i)} : R[X] \to R$. Formally, $\operatorname{eval}_f \circ \operatorname{toMvPolynomial}_i = \operatorname{eval}_{f(i)}$.

items.informal_name: Evaluation of Generator Polynomial at Generators Yields Original Element
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {ι : Type w} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S]
  (P : Algebra.Generators R S ι) (s : S), (MvPolynomial.aeval P.val) (P.σ s) = s
items.informal_description: For an algebra $ S $ over a commutative ring $ R $ with generators $ P $, evaluating the polynomial representation $ P.\sigma(s) $ of an element $ s \in S $ at the generators $ P.\text{val} $ recovers the original element $ s $. Formally, for all $ s \in S $, $ \text{aeval}_{P.\text{val}}(P.\sigma(s)) = s $, where $ \text{aeval} $ denotes the algebra evaluation homomorphism.

items.informal_name: Lifted Homomorphism Equals Original Function on Generators
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {A : Type u_3} [inst_1 : Semiring A] [inst_2 : Algebra R A]
  (f : X → A) (x : X), ((FreeAlgebra.lift R) f) (FreeAlgebra.ι R x) = f x
items.informal_description: For any function $ f : X \to A $ and generator $ x \in X $, the algebra homomorphism induced by $ f $ satisfies $ \text{lift}_R(f)(\iota(x)) = f(x) $.

items.type:
(R : Type u_1) →
  {X : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CommSemiring R] →
      {A : Type u_3} → [inst_1 : Semiring A] → [inst_2 : Algebra R A] → (X → A) ≃ (FreeAlgebra R X →ₐ[R] A)
items.informal_description: The equivalence between functions from a generating set $ X $ to an $ R $-algebra $ A $ and $ R $-algebra homomorphisms from the free algebra $ \text{FreeAlgebra}(R, X) $ to $ A $. This establishes that every function $ f : X → A $ extends uniquely to an $ R $-algebra homomorphism $ \text{FreeAlgebra}(R, X) → A $, preserving addition, multiplication, and scalar multiplication by $ R $, while respecting the quotient relations that make scalars central in the free algebra.

items.name: MvPolynomial.eval₂_X
items.type: {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S₁] (f : R →+* S₁) (g : σ → S₁) (n : σ) : MvPolynomial.eval₂ f g (MvPolynomial.X n) = g n
